library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# Function to generate datasets for different scenarios
generate_scenario_data <- function(scenario = "batch_effect") {
  set.seed(42)
  n_samples <- 100
  n_genes <- 50
  
  # Create base metadata
  default_data <- tibble(
    SampleID = paste0("S", 1:n_samples),
    Condition = rep(c("Healthy", "Disease"), each = n_samples/2),
    Batch = rep(c("Batch A", "Batch B"), times = n_samples/2)
  )
  
  # Generate baseline expression
  expr_matrix <- matrix(rnorm(n_samples * n_genes, mean = 10, sd = 2), nrow = n_samples)
  
  if (scenario == "normal") {
    # Normal: Only biological effect, minimal batch effect
    # Add Biological Effect (clear separation)
    expr_matrix[1:(n_samples/2), 1:5] <- expr_matrix[1:(n_samples/2), 1:5] + 3
    
    # Add minimal random batch effect
    batch_b_indices <- which(default_data$Batch == "Batch B")
    expr_matrix[batch_b_indices, 6:10] <- expr_matrix[batch_b_indices, 6:10] + 0.5
    
  } else if (scenario == "batch_effect") {
    # Batch Effect: Large batch effect dominating PC1
    # Add Biological Effect (Small variance)
    expr_matrix[1:(n_samples/2), 1:5] <- expr_matrix[1:(n_samples/2), 1:5] + 2
    
    # Add Batch Effect (Large variance, dominating PC1)
    batch_b_indices <- which(default_data$Batch == "Batch B")
    expr_matrix[batch_b_indices, 6:25] <- expr_matrix[batch_b_indices, 6:25] + 8
    
  } else if (scenario == "selection_bias") {
    # Selection Bias: Condition is confounded with batch
    # Make Disease samples mostly in Batch B, Healthy mostly in Batch A
    disease_indices <- which(default_data$Condition == "Disease")
    healthy_indices <- which(default_data$Condition == "Healthy")
    
    # Assign batches with confounding
    batch_assignment <- character(n_samples)
    batch_assignment[disease_indices] <- sample(c("Batch A", "Batch B"), length(disease_indices), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.2, 0.8))
    batch_assignment[healthy_indices] <- sample(c("Batch A", "Batch B"), length(healthy_indices), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.8, 0.2))
    
    default_data$Batch <- batch_assignment
    
    # Add moderate biological effect
    expr_matrix[default_data$Condition == "Disease", 1:5] <- expr_matrix[default_data$Condition == "Disease", 1:5] + 2.5
    
    # Add moderate batch effect
    batch_b_indices <- which(default_data$Batch == "Batch B")
    expr_matrix[batch_b_indices, 6:15] <- expr_matrix[batch_b_indices, 6:15] + 3
  }
  
  expr_df <- as.data.frame(expr_matrix)
  colnames(expr_df) <- paste0("Gene_", 1:n_genes)
  bind_cols(default_data, expr_df)
}

# Generate default dataset (batch effect by default)
default_df <- generate_scenario_data("batch_effect")

#| edit: false
#| output: false

# Reactive expression to load data
dataset <- reactive({
  if (input$data_source == "upload" && !is.null(input$user_file)) {
    # Use uploaded file
    return(read.csv(input$user_file$datapath, stringsAsFactors = TRUE))
  } else {
    # Use the selected scenario
    return(generate_scenario_data(input$scenario))
  }
})

# Update dropdown choices based on uploaded dataset
observeEvent(dataset(), {
  df <- dataset()
  # Guess categorical columns for the dropdowns
  cat_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, function(x) is.character(x) | is.factor(x))]
  numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
  
  updateSelectInput(session, "cond_col", choices = cat_cols, 
                    selected = ifelse("Condition" %in% cat_cols, "Condition", ifelse(length(cat_cols) > 0, cat_cols[1], NULL)))
  batch_choices <- c("None" = "None", setNames(cat_cols, cat_cols))
  updateSelectInput(session, "batch_col", choices = batch_choices, 
                    selected = ifelse("Batch" %in% cat_cols, "Batch", "None"))
  updateSelectInput(session, "feature_cols", choices = numeric_cols, selected = numeric_cols)
})

# Perform PCA (isolate only numeric columns)
pca_result <- reactive({
  df <- dataset()
  numeric_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
  selected_features <- input$feature_cols
  if (is.null(selected_features) || length(selected_features) == 0) {
    selected_features <- numeric_cols
  }
  num_data <- df %>% select(all_of(intersect(selected_features, numeric_cols)))
  
  # Remove columns with zero variance to prevent prcomp errors
  num_data <- num_data[, apply(num_data, 2, var) != 0]
  
  pca <- prcomp(num_data, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  
  # Bind PC1 and PC2 back to the original categorical data
  pca_data <- bind_cols(df, as_tibble(pca$x[, 1:2]))
  
  # Calculate variance explained for axes
  var_explained <- round(pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2) * 100, 1)
  
  list(data = pca_data, var = var_explained)
})

# Render Condition Plot
output$pca_condition_plot <- renderPlot({
  req(input$cond_col)
  res <- pca_result()
  
  ggplot(res$data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = .data[[input$cond_col]])) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("PC1 (", res$var[1], "% Variance)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", res$var[2], "% Variance)"),
      color = "Condition"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
})

# Render Batch Plot
output$pca_batch_plot <- renderPlot({
  req(input$batch_col)
  res <- pca_result()
  
  if (input$batch_col == "None") {
    # Only show condition, no batch shape
    ggplot(res$data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = .data[[input$cond_col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 5, alpha = 0.85) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
      labs(
        x = paste0("PC1 (", res$var[1], "% Variance)"),
        y = paste0("PC2 (", res$var[2], "% Variance)"),
        color = "Biological Condition"
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey90")
      )
  } else {
    # Show both condition color and batch shape
    ggplot(res$data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, 
                         color = .data[[input$cond_col]], 
                         shape = .data[[input$batch_col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 5, alpha = 0.85) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
      labs(
        x = paste0("PC1 (", res$var[1], "% Variance)"),
        y = paste0("PC2 (", res$var[2], "% Variance)"),
        color = "Biological Condition",
        shape = "Processing Batch"
      ) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.box = "vertical",
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey90")
      )
  }
})
